decision_rule: Admit only if key-action anchoring preserves M133 strict proof-surface diversity while fixed losses and behavior remain acceptable.
failure_criteria: lost M133 keys still disappear under strict rollout gate
fixed losses improve by changing retained-key actions despite anchor
implementation introduces hidden or oracle actor inputs
hypothesis: M138 shows retained keys can get lower logprob penalty while disappearing from rollout selection. A direct action-mean anchor on the M136 retained keys may preserve rollout behavior better than minimizing retained-key logprob alone.
success_criteria: focused tests cover any new objective or optimizer path
M136 retained-key action drift is constrained against M132
behavior success remains at M132 level
strict selected pairs and seeds meet or exceed M133 on both miner seeds
